user.title: GMX account and MCP access
user.description: Enter the GMX address and an app password (GMX: Account > Login & Security > App passwords). IMAP/POP3 access must be enabled in GMX. Only access tokens of the chosen Home Assistant user can use the MCP endpoint; create a dedicated user for it.

data_description.email: Full address, also used as the login name.
data_description.password: Stored in Home Assistant, never shown again.
data_description.allowed_user: Requests with a token or login of any other user are rejected (403).

server.description: GMX defaults; change only for another provider.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to GMX again
reauth_confirm.description: GMX rejected the login for {account}. Either the app password was revoked or GMX switched off IMAP access after a period without use. Check the IMAP setting in GMX and enter an app password.

reconfigure.title: Change {account}
reconfigure.description: Allowed user and server settings. Address and password stay unchanged.

abort.no_users: There is no active Home Assistant user to choose.

init.title: MCP access and tools
init.description:
**Connection URL:** `{url}`

**claude.ai:** add a custom connector with this URL and sign in with the allowed Home Assistant user.

**Claude Code:** create a long-lived access token as the allowed user (Profile > Security), then run:

`{claude_code}`

Only the tools switched on below are visible and callable. Default: read-only tools.

data_description.enabled_tools: Changes apply immediately, without a restart.

invalid_auth_or_imap_disabled.message: GMX rejected the login: wrong app password, or IMAP access is switched off.

tls_error.message: Secure connection to the mail server failed.

cannot_connect.message: The mail server cannot be reached.

imap_possibly_disabled.title: GMX login rejected for {account}
imap_possibly_disabled.description: GMX rejected the login. GMX switches IMAP access off after a period without use, and then reports a wrong password. Enable "POP3 and IMAP access" in the GMX settings again, then re-authenticate the integration (new app password if it was revoked).
